title: Industrialized Deception: The Collateral Effects of LLM-Generated Misinformation on Digital Ecosystems
abstract: arXiv:2601.21963v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Generative AI and misinformation research have evolved since our 2024 survey. This paper presents an updated perspective, transitioning from literature review to practical countermeasures. We report on changes in the threat landscape, including improved AI-generated content through Large Language Models (LLMs) and multimodal systems - addressing the adverse impacts of AI on information quality.   This work focuses on our practical contributions: JudgeGPT, a platform to evaluate human perception of AI-generated news, and RogueGPT, a controlled stimulus generation engine for research. Together, these tools form an experimental pipeline for studying how humans perceive and detect AI-generated misinformation.   Our findings show that detection capabilities have improved, but competition between generation and detection continues. translated_title: 工业化的欺骗：大语言模型生成的虚假信息对数字生态系统的连带效应
translated_abstract: 自我们2024年的综述以来，生成式人工智能与虚假信息研究已取得进展。本文提出了一个更新的视角，从文献综述转向实际应对措施。我们报告了威胁态势的变化，包括通过大语言模型（LLM）和多模态系统生成的AI内容质量的提升——并探讨了AI对信息质量造成的不利影响。本工作聚焦于我们的实际贡献：JudgeGPT，一个评估人类对AI生成新闻感知能力的平台；以及RogueGPT，一个用于研究的可控刺激生成引擎。这两个工具共同构成了一个实验流水线，用于研究人类如何感知和检测AI生成的虚假信息。我们的研究结果表明，检测能力有所提升，但内容生成与检测之间的竞争仍在持续。我们讨论了多种缓解策略，如基于LLM的检测、“接种”式免疫方法，以及双重用途问题。
tldr: 本文提出JudgeGPT和RogueGPT两个实用工具，构成研究人类如何感知与检测AI生成虚假信息的实验流水线，发现检测能力虽有提升，但AI内容生成与检测之间的对抗竞争仍在持续。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces JudgeGPT and RogueGPT, two practical tools forming an experimental pipeline to study how humans perceive and detect AI-generated misinformation, finding that while detection capabilities have improved, the ongoing competition between generation and detection continues.
